hypotheses.reasoning: At 12:00:03 notification-svc v3.31.0 started rolling out with config revision 738 (#3385). At 12:00:28 that revision reloaded and changed one key, TEMPLATE_SVC_URL=http://template-svc.internal:8081 (#3490). From 12:00:56 notification-svc calls to template-svc fail at once with ECONNREFUSED to 10.25.98.71:8081 (#3580, #3699, #3831, #4015). template-svc itself looks healthy: it keeps logging normal GC pauses, has no errors, and still answers the occasional request (#3753 at 12:02:20, probably from a pod still on the old config). So the problem is the new endpoint, not template-svc. notification-svc then returns 503 to api-gateway, which is the drop to 5% success on POST /v1/notify. The timing matches the rollout, and nothing else hits this path. The notif-worker deploy (#3007) touches a different path, and the accounts-db disk-full errors only affect /login on edge-proxy. The webhook 502s and legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts were already present or are unrelated.

Another reading is that the wrong TEMPLATE_SVC_URL is a config-service error rather than part of the release. But it came in as the config revision bundled with the v3.31.0 rollout, which fits bad_deploy better.
Connection refused could also mean template-svc stopped listening. That seems unlikely because the process stays alive and still served a request at #3753.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll notification-svc back to the previous version and config revision, or set TEMPLATE_SVC_URL back to the known-good template-svc endpoint. Check that template-svc.internal:8081 resolves to the live template-svc pods before redeploying v3.31.0. Track the accounts-db disk-full problem (/login failures) as a separate incident.
